title: Creative & Content Strategist (US Client Facing)
description:
**Job Title:** Creative \& Content Strategist (US Client Facing)

**Company:** Arijentek Solution Private Limited

**Location:** Pollachi (India)

**Salary:** \[₹2,40,000to ₹5,00,000 per year (2\.4 LPA to 5\.0 LPA)]

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Working Hours:** Afternoon Shift, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

**About Us**

At Arijentek, we build bridges between exceptional talent in India and growing businesses in the US. Our internal teams of developers, designers, and support staff work seamlessly to deliver high\-quality digital solutions. We are currently looking for a creative, highly organized strategist to serve as the dedicated link between our US clients and our execution teams.

**What You'll Do**

You will take full ownership of the client's creative design, concept generation, and monthly content calendar. Working directly with the US client team, you will gather content requirements and act as their dedicated day\-to\-day resource. You will coordinate with our internal team to bring your creative concepts to life, producing 20 core social posts each month, which must include four short\-form videos. You will also adapt and repurpose this content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profiles.

In addition to creative work, you will provide account coordination, handle client approvals, schedule meetings, and participate in monthly optimization meetings and quarterly performance reviews. While you won't be leading technical marketing campaigns, you will assist our technical team with organic SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI\-search visibility strategies when necessary.

**Who We're Looking For**

We need a design\-focused creative who communicates flawlessly and can bridge the gap between a US client's vision and an offshore team's execution. You don't need to be a technical digital marketing expert, but you must have enough foundational knowledge of SEO, GA4, and conversion tracking to ensure your creative assets support broader marketing goals.

* Exceptional writers and communicators who are highly comfortable presenting to US stakeholders.
* Creative thinkers with a proven ability to design compelling digital assets and storyboard short videos.
* Highly organized individuals who can manage a complex publishing calendar and track project deadlines.
* Collaborative professionals who can assist with maintaining Google Business Profiles and local citations when needed.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal English: clear, precise, and professional.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating social media design, conceptual thinking, and video storyboarding.
* A working knowledge of modern search principles (organic SEO, AEO) and social media analytics.
* Experience managing client approvals and coordinating projects.
* Able to commute to and work from our Pollachi office for required in\-person days.

**Technical Requirements (Hybrid)**

* A dedicated, quiet home workspace with reliable high\-speed internet for your remote days.
* (Note: All necessary hardware and high\-speed internet will be provided at your dedicated workstation when in the office).

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** \[2\.4 LPA to 5\.0 LPA], based on experience and performance.
* **On\-Site \& Remote Flexibility:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with a balanced hybrid schedule at our Pollachi office.
* **Support \& Growth:** Clear guidelines, comprehensive onboarding, and the opportunity to lead creative direction for US clients.
* **Impact:** Join a mission\-driven team where your creative concepts directly shape our clients' digital presence and success.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* This role requires working an afternoon shift from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST to ensure maximum overlap with our US clients. Are you completely comfortable and able to commit to this daily schedule?
* This role acts as the dedicated liaison bridging a US client's vision with our internal India\-based team of developers and designers. Can you share an example of how you have successfully managed cross\-functional communication and expectations?
* Please provide a direct link to your portfolio showcasing your digital design concepts, social media assets, and video storyboarding.
* While this is primarily a creative role, you will be supporting technical marketing teams with organic SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Can you briefly explain your foundational knowledge of modern search principles and how you ensure your creative assets are SEO\-friendly?
* Are you able to reliably commute to our Pollachi office for the required on\-site days each week?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pollachi, Tamil Nadu

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**

* Work closely with engineering and product management to plan, create, and maintain user\-focused technical documentation for multiple product features or applications, in alignment with an established content strategy
* Provide input to help shape future content strategy for the product or business unit you help to support
* Contribute to the continued evolution of ServiceNow’s content development processes, DITA\-based information model, and writing style and standards
* Develop a strong understanding of the ServiceNow product ecosystem and expert knowledge of the specific product area and user base you support

  

**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Demonstrate English language proficiency through an assessment via HackerRank, evaluating grammar, sentence structure, and skills in clear, user\-centric, and procedural writing.
* Understanding of content development life cycles and processes
* 5\+ years work experience in technical communication
* Samples of your prior technical writing work or other writing that demonstrates your ability to communicate complex ideas and technical information clearly
* Experience authoring in the Darwin Information Typing Architecture (DITA) or another XML\-based structured authoring architecture
* Experience independently planning, creating, and delivering documentation in a fast\-paced, globally distributed software development environment
* Ability and eagerness to demonstrate leadership by mentoring other writers, adapting quickly to changing priorities, and helping diverse cross\-functional teams collaborate effectively to deliver exceptional results

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**


We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**


For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Controls Documentation Engineer
description:
**Brief Job Description:**  

Technical Writer:


Responsible for researching, writing and editing customer\-facing documentation such as user manuals, online help systems and quick installation guides. Able to work with and facilitate positive relationships with Global Business Units (GBUs), all Lines of Business (LOB), other departments and OEM customers with specific needs. With guided supervision and sometimes limited product specifications, can fully support and manage both local and remote documentation projects from start to finish.


**Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:**

**(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)**

* Researches, writes and edits various product documentation for advanced technology products in English language.
* Gathers technical information proactively. Research available engineering information. Interviews engineers and other technical personnel to ensure the clarity, completeness, accuracy and quality of the documents created.
* Assembles documentation in correct Vertiv or OEM format, keeping structure, content and organization consistent with established standards and styles.
* Develops online help, API documentation and Command Reference Guides for software applications per established standards, styles and guidelines.
* Able to manage multiple complex project schedules across multiple product lines and businesses.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

**Required/ Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 3 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSC\- any stream/BCA or equivalent degree). Additional degrees/certifications in professional writing, technical writing, digital writing/communications, journalism or English are preferred. At least 5 or more years of equivalent experience in a relevant field may be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

**Additional / Preferred Qualifications:**

* Fluent in and able to communicate, understand and explain complex concepts in English.
* Experience with writing for localization and working with international teams.
* Experience with CSS, XML and XHTML.
* Proficiency in the following programs: Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat DC Pro, Adobe InDesign and Madcap Flare (or equivalent experience with a single\-source desktop publishing tool).
* Strong interpersonal, communication and editing skills with high attention to detail.
* Self\-motivated with the desire to be a team\-player and support team goals and mission.
* Ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced, international team environment with multiple deadlines, limited resources and constant change.
* Ability to support multiple time zones when needed.

**Physical \& Environmental Requirements: \- (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)**

* Standard physical demands of desk work

**Time Travel Needed:**

* 25%
